# AI Zhangle Agent Design System

This repository is an Agent-readable design-system source for AI Zhangle / New Zhangle mobile screens.

Start with:

- `SKILL.md`: canonical Agent behavior, task routing, business keywords, editing rules, Figma generation constraints, and delivery requirements.
- `manifest.json`: machine-readable path index.
- `DESIGN.md`: visual generation, visual review, design tasting, hierarchy, density, atmosphere, and polish.

`AGENTS.md` is a compatibility entry only. Do not treat it as a separate rule source.

Human-authored inputs live under `authoring/`. Canonical machine-readable truth lives under `canon/`. Figma and local resource bindings live under `bindings/`. Low-fidelity HTML renderer rules live under `renderers/`.

For component work, treat `authoring/components/*.brief.yaml` as the human-authored input and expand it into `canon/components/`, `canon/checklists/`, `bindings/figma/components.yaml`, and `docs/generated/components/index.md` when needed.

For scenario or page work, use `SKILL.md` business routing keywords first, then load the matching `authoring/scenarios/`, `canon/scenarios/`, `canon/archetypes/`, component meta, Figma bindings, and review checklists.
